published_ranges._notes: The V3.0 TDS check was not completed: the wiki.bambulab.com V3.0 PDF returned a client error. Nozzle, bed, drying, speed, density, Vicat and HDT are from reseller summaries of the TDS (crea3d, 3DJake). HDT 0.45 MPa = 194C is also stated on Bambu's own store page. A reseller copy of Bambu's PAHT-CF TDS V2.0 (machines-3d.com) gives 'Heat Deflection Temperature ISO 75 1.8 MPa 170 °C', 'Cooling Fan 0 - 40%' and 'Chamber Temperature 45 - 60 °C'. This is V2.0; V3.0 is still unchecked. Bambu's store says 'PAHT-CF is an upgraded version of PA-CF (PA-CF was discontinued)'. Earlier entry: TDS V2.0. Support material: Bambu Support for PA/PET. Plates: Engineering, High Temperature or Textured PEI. Max overhang ~70 deg, bridging ~40 mm. A V3.0 TDS exists (uwaterloo.ca copy) but was not read. PDF hosted on cdn.shopify.com.
published_ranges._hardened_nozzle_required: Stainless steel nozzle NOT recommended (official store page)
published_ranges._ams: AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT and AMS compatible; AMS lite NOT compatible
